# Clinic growth

Stores the measurable growth system for Expert Dental Studio and later directly controlled RAIMOV DENTAL clinics: baseline, priority services, capacity, offers, diagnostic-product economics, treatment-plan conversion, retention, internal referrals and success-fee inputs.

**Retention / loyalty canon:** `docs/ssot/EXPERT_DENTAL_PATIENT_MOTIVATION_SYSTEM.md` (DEC-786/861) — Continuity + RAIM SMILE · SmileCare 12 + Expert Points. Cohort economics for SmileCare/Points must stay separate from advertising spend and success-fee formulas.

**Reputation / review collection:** Post-Visit Feedback Loop (DEC-787) — CSAT after visit → 4–5: guidance `/write` then maps `/maps` / 1–3: private recovery; ops SOP `docs/raimov/operations/expert-dental/reputation/POST_VISIT_FEEDBACK_LOOP.md`. No review rewards.

Required rule: separate activity, funnel movement and cash received. No target or success-fee formula is canonical until baseline, attribution and clinic approval exist.
